request.what: Reimburse Ikigai Info Governance Action Deposit.
deliverables: In September 2024, only weeks after the Chang hard fork to introduce on-chain governance, an Info governance action titled Cardanoの生きがい - Ikigai - was submitted.

This was only a symbolic governance action, as it simply asked the community whether they agreed with a statement thanking those that helped get Cardano to this point and expressing a sense of hope for the future.

Unfortunately, due to a bug in the code of the Cardano node that permitted an unregistered stake key to be used in the governance action, the submitter was unable to recover their deposit of 100K ada.

There was significant sentiment at the time that the Ikigai Info governance action deposit should be reimbursed.
It was considered that the submitter should not lose one hundred thousand ada, for being an early pioneer of Cardano governance.
This is a budget Info governance action requesting an amount of 103,000 ada.
In addition to the original 100,000 ada the Ikigai Info governance action submitter lost, they have since lost staking rewards, Midnight airdrop eligibility and other opportunities.
